contract-traceability.name: Contract reading and traceability
contract-traceability.what: Connect the written rule to the code boundary and exact assertion.
contract-traceability.why: A passing test establishes only the behavior its oracle actually checks.
contract-traceability.how: Show the unchanged contract, name its clause, then point to the matching test and repair.

causal-explanation.how: Trace the smallest relevant path using the prepared fixture and distinguish cause, defect and observed failure.
causal-explanation.result: State the mechanism supported by the actual run; preserve uncertainty if the evidence differs.

test-sensitivity.evidenceRequired: Actual timestamped behavior/explanation from the selected attempt; reference rehearsal is technical preparation only.

controlled-edit.name: Small bounded manual change
